meta.notes: A worldgen/biome tag gives one name to several worldgen/biome ids. values lists ids or other tags (written #namespace:path); set replace to true only to wipe what other packs put in a tag of the same id. A structure lists a biome tag in its biomes field, so pointing a structure at #msm_examples:has_structure/meadow_cabin lets it generate in exactly these biomes.
